svg.title: EncodeIt watch folder integrations
svg.desc: After Effects, Premiere Pro, and DaVinci Resolve export to watch folders. Files settle, enter the EncodeIt queue, and FFmpeg encodes them to Output. EncodeIt processes files after the host finishes exporting. This is file handoff, not a native host codec replacement.

g.aria-label: Hand off finished renders through watch folders.
EncodeIt processes files after the host finishes exporting.
File handoff — not a native host codec replacement.
